extension_points.name: Accessibility (AX) API
extension_points.detail: every app; needs the Accessibility permission, reads and drives the UI

routes.name: settings and data files
routes.reason: cheapest, but reaches only what the app already reads; state: ~/Library/Application Support/Spotify, ~/Library/Preferences/com.spotify.client.plist

routes.name: AppleScript dictionary
routes.reason: drive the app from osascript within its dictionary; cannot add UI

routes.name: URL schemes
routes.reason: deep links (spotify://); trigger only. Caveat: `open` routes to an already-running instance, which may be the user's real profile

routes.name: Accessibility (AX) API
routes.reason: read and drive the UI; needs the Accessibility permission and acting through it is driving input, so ask first; the cef UI exposes a thin AX tree

routes.name: renderer script via DevTools Protocol
routes.reason: launch-time renderer script over the DevTools Protocol (--remote-debugging-port, lab profile, session only); app files untouched; check the app's terms first: a prohibition on client modification puts this out of scope

routes.name: network capture of the app's own traffic
routes.reason: your own account and data only; rarely needed for an app mod

routes.name: companion tool beside the app
routes.reason: rebuild the part you need next to the app, from its data files or API; most work, and the user sees it outside the app

routes.name: edit the app's files
routes.reason: editing a signed bundle breaks its seal: that defeats an integrity check
